title: Care Centre Guidance: After-Hours Premium Share by Booking on Harbison Parts-and-Labor Protection Claims
content:
**The rule.** The premium share of a claim against a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts follows how the service call was booked, as the call shows under Repair and Emergency Service Calls — the symptom it was booked for, the date it was booked and its scheduled date.

- On a tier that covers the after-hours premium, a call booked for any symptom other than no heat, no cooling or a carbon monoxide alarm takes a premium share of zero.
- On a tier that covers the after-hours premium, a call booked for one of those symptoms one or more calendar days before its scheduled date takes the booked-ahead premium share of 0.50.
- Any other call takes the tier's own after-hours coverage, which is one on a tier that covers the premium and zero on a tier that does not.

The premium paid is the premium net times the premium share, only on the first claim decided on the service call. The premium net is the after-hours premium charged on the call less the member premium discount posted against it.

**Truth table.**

| Tier covers the after-hours premium | Booked symptom | Booked one or more calendar days before the scheduled date | Premium share |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | other than no heat, no cooling or carbon monoxide alarm | either | 0 |
| yes | no heat, no cooling or carbon monoxide alarm | yes | 0.50 |
| yes | no heat, no cooling or carbon monoxide alarm | no (booked for its own day) | 1 |
| no | any | either | 0 |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical, premium net $120.00, first claim decided on the call, tier covering the premium).**

- No-heat call booked at 9 p.m. for that same evening: share 1, premium paid $120.00.
- No-cooling call booked on a Friday for the Saturday: one calendar day ahead, share 0.50, premium paid $60.00.
- Call booked for a noisy blower: share 0, premium paid $0.00.
